description: This file implements a React component for a login page with a two-step flow: first collecting email to fetch user organizations, then allowing the user to select an organization or input one manually, and finally submitting login credentials. It manages state, handles API calls, and performs navigation upon successful login.

classes.name: Organization
classes.description: TypeScript type defining the structure of an organization object with id, optional name, and other key-value pairs.

methods.name: handleFetchOrgs
methods.description: Handles the form submission to fetch user organizations based on email input, updates state accordingly.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles the login form submission, performs validation, API call, and navigation upon success.
